body: Second hero shipped from the batched next-wave entry. Vassago is real TYLER canon: the Eastwind Owls' whole working frequency (11.11 Hz) is his, per TYLER/CLAUDE.md's own Goetia frequency table. Full kit: passive HP regen, ranged damage+silence Q, ally next_cast_refund W (first hero to make this ability its primary W), and the roster's first purely-control R -- a silence-only zone with zero damage. ARENA_HERO_COUNT 22->23. Found and fixed a real design issue while testing: first-draft silence duration was shorter than the zone's own tick interval, leaving real gaps in continuous silence -- fixed by matching Flamel's proven margin. 6 new tests, full suite (324 checks), VS0/VS1 stable. Verified live: a real match drafted 20 distinct heroes with zero duplicates, Vassago/Cain/Gunnr all included. Commit 0d5b575.
title: Vassago, 23rd hero -- second from the batched hero-wave (S170-93)
